# VueDevTools Source Jump Needs Editor Config
Vue DevTools jump-to-source requires an editor launch command configured in the dev environment.
## Root Cause
- Vue DevTools "Open in editor" needs `launch-editor` middleware with an editor start command configured
- Without the config, clicking the component panel button cannot jump to source
## Setup
- Write the editor launch command into the project dev config
- Run `npm run dev`, then click "Open in editor" in the component panel

# onOpen And watch Double Trigger Duplicate Dialog Calls
Both `onOpen` and the `maintenanceObjectId` watcher call `loadDialogData()`, and `$nextTick` with `v-if` mounting `commonTable` overlap to cause duplicate requests.
## Root Cause
- `onOpen` and `maintenanceObjectId` watch both invoke `loadDialogData()`
- `$nextTick` and `v-if` mounting `commonTable` timing stacking causes repeated requests
## Fix
- Remove `maintenanceObjectId` watch and its `loadDialogData`
- `onOpen` only fills the form
- `commonTable` with `autoQuery=false` calls `getQuery()` once in `mounted`, guarded by `v-if="$attrs.visible"`

# listMixins Requires queryParams Or Assignment Errors
`listMixins.js` `created` hook runs `Object.assign(this.queryParams, val)` via the `query` setter, so components importing it must declare `queryParams`.
## Root Cause
- `listMixins.js` created hook does `Object.assign(this.queryParams, val)` through the query setter
- A component importing the mixin without `queryParams` declared triggers `Cannot convert undefined` error
## Convention
- Any component importing `listMixins` must define a `queryParams` data attribute

# Non-modal Dialog Keeps Stale Data When Switching Rows
`zs-dialog` with `modal="false"` does not block the table; switching rows keeps `visible` true so `@open` never fires and `onOpen` reads the old ID.
## Root Cause
- `zs-dialog` `modal="false"` does not overlay the table
- Switching rows keeps `visible` always true, so `@open` never triggers
- `onOpen` calls `getList` before props update, reading the old ID
## Fix
- `refundDetailTable.vue` adds `:key="currentMaintenanceObjectId"` to force re-creation
- `handleView` uses `{...row}` copy
- `refundDetailDialog.vue` extracts `loadDialogData` into `$nextTick` and watches `maintenanceObjectId` to refresh
